_open_questions_surfaced.question: Convention 2 (observed_on) has no case for a nominee report. The form's Date of Appointment is blank (the filing predates confirmation/appointment); the new-entrant rule anchors on the appointment / 208-trigger date, which does not exist on the form. observed_on on all cp_filing_0005 edges is PROVISIONALLY set to the filer-signature date 2025-01-25, documented here rather than assigned silently. Candidate resolutions for a later determination: filer-signature date (2025-01-25), Senate confirmation (2025-05-19, PN24-4), or swearing-in (2025-07-11). Don't-pre-resolve governs; the convention is extended when the maintainer rules.

Live 18 USC 208(a)(2) spousal-imputation cases: Westminster Management, LLC (spouse retains equity, Part 5, $5M-$25M) and Westminster Pillar Management, LLC (Part 6 item 107, $5M-$25M, Management Fees $100,001-$250,000; spouse equity + fees per Ethics Agreement Section 4). Ethics Agreement Appendix B (~150 publicly-traded securities + foreign equities) plus the SPDR S&P Biotech ETF and Millennium USA LP (Section 3), and the Part 6 public-equity block (pp 18-43), are DIVESTED within 90 days of confirmation per the Ethics Agreement (2025-04-14) and Certification (2025-08-22). Logged here, not flooded into the registry as soft-flagged entities.

Certification Section 3b indicates no 278-T was filed for the divestitures, yet a 278-T dated 09/26/2025 was requested/expected. Hold the tension; the 278-T gets its own ingest when it arrives and the discrepancy is a determination then.
